narrative.intro: Four Seasons Environmental has $52M in federal contract obligations in FY2027 to date. Four Seasons Environmental recorded 4 awards so far this fiscal year, with an average award size of $13M. Obligations were down 4.2% year over year. Four Seasons Environmental received the bulk of its FY2027 obligations from the Department of Health and Human Services, which obligated $51.9M. Four Seasons Environmental also recorded obligations from the General Services Administration, which obligated $77.6K. Four Seasons Environmental obligations have risen and fallen across recent years: $43M in FY22, $46M in FY23, $51M in FY24, $57.4M in FY25, $54.2M in FY26, and $52M in FY27. Four Seasons Environmental current-year totals are partial because FY2027 is year to date. Four Seasons Environmental award-count and average-award-size figures reflect obligations, while largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables report total contract values rather than obligations. Four Seasons Environmental position this fiscal year shows concentration in a single agency buyer and a modest year-over-year decline in obligations.

sections.heading: Who are the top buyers of Four Seasons Environmental in FY2027 to date?
sections.body: The Department of Health and Human Services is the top buyer, obligating $51.9M to Four Seasons Environmental. The General Services Administration is the other buyer listed, obligating $77.6K. Four Seasons Environmental obligations are highly concentrated in those two agencies this fiscal year.

sections.heading: How have Four Seasons Environmental obligations changed over recent fiscal years?
sections.body: Four Seasons Environmental obligations increased from $43M in FY22 to $57.4M in FY25, then declined to $54.2M in FY26 and to $52M in FY27. Obligations were down 4.2% year over year for the current reporting period. Four Seasons Environmental average award size for FY2027 to date is $13M across 4 awards.
